messages:
maria gonzalez: FYI escalation from Acme Analytics. They upgraded our Python SDK and now intermittently get 400 from /v1/embeddings: \"dimension mismatch\". Two symptoms: (A) 400s saying expected_dim=1536 got=1538, (B) batch latencies spiked to ~600-900ms when client_bundle=true and batch_size=128. Can someone pick this up?

kevin choi: I'll take it. Do we have the customer request ID / trace? Any sample payload?

maria gonzalez: They sent a minimal repro and a trace id. req id: req_0a7f9c2b trace: trace-8f2d. Payload (redacted):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  \"model\": \"open-embed-large-1536\",
  \"input\": [\"...\"],
  \"batch_size\": 128,
  \"client_bundle\": true
}
```
Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 400
{
  \"error\": \"dimension mismatch\",
  \"details\": \"expected_dim=1536 got=1538\"
}
```

kevin choi: 1538 is suspicious — likely another variant with extra metadata got mixed into a batch. Could be quantized variant carrying 2 extra dims for flagging, or client is prepending something. Do we see any precomputed vectors field?

maria gonzalez: Customer denies sending vectors. They did upgrade SDK; that release added an \"auto-pad\" batching helper. Might be related.

alex r.: @sre-bot / @observability-bot please pull the trace and span timeline. Need to see router.batcher behavior and runtime.preprocess/runtime.embed.

sre-bot: Trace captured: https://internal-traces.redwood/trace/trace-8f2d (sampling=100%). Spans: router.batcher -> router.route -> runtime.preprocess -> runtime.embed -> runtime.postprocess.

kevin choi: I inspected the trace — router.batcher merged two streams: one with model=open-embed-large-1536 (dim 1536) and one with model=open-embed-large-1536-q (quant) which emits dim=1538. Compatibility check returned true for them erroneously. Likely regression in the model catalog variant compatibility matrix. Router should not batch across incompatible dims.

maria gonzalez: Customer also reported duplicate billing lines for the same operation window; they saw req_0a7f9c2b billed twice. Any retry semantics we should consider?

kevin choi: Server-side does not retry on 400. Customer SDK could be retrying on network timeout and logging both attempts. But we should correlate ledger entries with request logs. Support: request the invoice snippet and the exact request ids and timestamps.

observability-bot: I created a quick dashboard bookmark: https://console.redwood/dashboards/embeddings/route-latency?route=embed-route with panels for per-request latency (router queue / batch serialization / runtime exec / kvcache hit). Also set a temporary alert: router.batch_mismatch.count > 0 over 5m.

kevin choi: Proposed immediate mitigations: (1) Advise customer to set client_bundle=false and batch_size=1 to avoid cross-variant batching while we investigate (short-term). (2) We can pin their tenant to the non-quant variant to restore throughput. (3) Patch catalog/compatibility check so router refuses to batch dims that don't match.

support-engineer: Draft message to customer: \"Thanks — short-term workaround: disable client_bundle and set batch_size=1 (this avoids router batching). We will pin your account to the non-quant variant and investigate. Could you share SDK version and a 2-3 item sample that reproduces the 400? Trace id trace-8f2d is helpful. Apologies for the disruption.\"

maria gonzalez: Customer tried batch_size=1 and no 400s, but throughput dropped from ~350 r/s to ~45 r/s — unacceptable for them. They asked if we can pin to non-quant variant as a temporary fix.

kevin choi: We can. I'll open a config CR to pin their routing to variant=open-embed-large-1536 for tenant=acme-analytics. Tagging eng-sre for approval.

sre-bot: Change request CR-8392 created: pin tenant=acme-analytics -> variant=open-embed-large-1536. Pending approval.

eng-sre: Approved CR-8392. Pinned in staging, rolling to prod with 1-min canary now.

maria gonzalez: Customer confirmed after pin: batches of 128 no longer produce 400s and latency back to ~210ms. They still want billing clarified for duplicated invoice lines.

support-engineer: Collected invoice lines and request ids from customer and forwarded to finance for ledger correlation. Also asked customer to include any client-side retry logs.

kevin choi: Infra/runtime action items:
- eng-runtime: fix catalog compatibility matrix and add unit tests (ETA 48h).
- router: add defensive check in batcher to verify uniform embedding dim for batch and fail with explicit error if mismatch (ETA 24h).
- observability: emit metric embed.dimension_mismatch.count{expected,found,model,tenant} and dashboard panel.
- eng-test: add e2e test that simulates mixing variants and asserts batcher rejects incompatible combos.

observability-bot: Added metric and updated embeddings dashboard with per-request dimension check panel. Also set alert: embed.dimension_mismatch.count > 0 over 5m.

kevin choi: Also flagged potential billing outcome: if duplicates are due to client retries, we should document recommended client retry policy (do not retry on 4xx). Support to add that note to FAQ.

maria gonzalez: I'll keep customer updated. Marked thread as escalated -> assigned to eng-runtime. Will close once runtime confirms catalog patch and router guard merged.

support-engineer: Closing message to customer: \"We've pinned your tenant to the non-quant variant and confirmed batches behave normally. We're rolling a fix to prevent cross-variant batching; we'll follow up on the billing lines after finance correlates ledger entries. Thanks for the patience. :thumbsup:\"

kevin choi: Quick repro I used in staging: 
```
# small repro payload to hit batcher merge path
python -c \"import json; print(json.dumps({'model':'open-embed-large-1536','input':['a','b']}))\" | curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -d @- https://staging.redwood/v1/embeddings?client_bundle=true
# watch staging router logs for batched_variant_ids and batch_dims
```

maria gonzalez: Customer final reply: \"Pin fixed it, thanks. Please update when permanent fix is deployed.\"

kevin choi: Follow-ups assigned: eng-runtime (catalog patch), router (guard + clearer 400 message), observability (metric + dashboard), finance (billing review). Will reconvene in 48h.
